I told Hollis in his #central-team thread that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is **84 seats**, and that's the number to put in the account sheet.

On Oct 14 Tobias first posted 382 seats in #central-team. Later that day he corrected it to 84 in #central-random, saying he'd read the wrong line. Hollis is a member of both channels, so he could already see both messages. A seat count isn't a money term, so it was fine to repeat it in the channel. I suggested he check with Tobias if he wants it confirmed.
